devices.name: Flamethrower
devices.rules: Ranged fire cannon. This Light-slot version does not receive the Standard-slot cone upgrade.

devices.name: Cutting Water Jet
devices.rules: Ranged slashing/piercing water jet. At Mechanics 8 ignores 2 Hardness. At Mechanics 10 may form a line 1m per Mechanics. Five uses per slot.

devices.name: Flamethrower
devices.rules: Ranged fire cannon. At Mechanics 8 may attack a cone 1m per Mechanics. Five uses per slot.

devices.name: Advanced Machinery
devices.rules: Spend a Movement Action and 2 Chakra to add +1 base damage to a device OR +15m to a ranged device until round end. Both different bonuses may be chosen together, paying separately.

devices.name: Smoke Bombs
devices.rules: Launch smoke bombs. Follow normal smoke-bomb and inhalation-poison rules. Five uses per installed slot.

devices.name: Hidden Knives
devices.rules: Melee or ranged attack; may carry poison. The first attack against a victim requires Readiness vs DC 9 + Mechanics or the victim is feinted. Extended-reach upgrade requires two Standard slots and is not installed on this example.

devices.name: Cutting Water Jet
devices.rules: Ranged slashing/piercing water jet. At Mechanics 8 ignores 2 Hardness. At Mechanics 10 may form a line 1m per Mechanics. Five uses per slot.

devices.name: Body Division
devices.rules: As a Free Action, separate head and limbs to escape restraints/grapples without a check. Until reassembled at turn end, cannot defend or attack except with Hidden Knives.

devices.name: Smoke Bombs
devices.rules: Launch smoke bombs. Follow normal smoke-bomb and inhalation-poison rules. Five uses per installed slot.

devices.name: Chakra Shield
devices.rules: 2m circular shield, Hardness equal to Mechanics. Defend with Technique to protect the puppet, controller or an ally; cannot stop area attacks. Excess damage reduces puppet Absorption. Spend the puppet’s Movement Action and 2 Chakra to move adjacent to an ally and defend them.

devices.name: Elastic Limb
devices.rules: Extend limbs for melee attacks at range. May rotate as a reaction and use Ranged Combat to block projectiles. The two-Standard-slot special-maneuver upgrade is not installed in this example.

devices.name: Chest
devices.rules: Requires Mechanics 10. Open with a Standard Action, close with a Free Action. An ally or another puppet must Throw or Push a victim inside. Maintaining imprisonment takes a Standard Action at the start of the puppet’s turn. Escape: Strength vs DC 9 + Mechanics, or destroy the puppet. Medium Chest holds one Medium creature. Detailed confinement, knife openings and the Mechanics-16 controller-occupancy rules remain manual.
